t: You're in the Sunken Garden at Kensington Palace, looking at the statue of Diana, Princess of Wales. Her sons, William and Harry, commissioned it on the twentieth anniversary of her death. The sculptor is Ian Rank-Broadley, who has also designed several British coin portraits. It was unveiled on the first of July 2021, which would have been her sixtieth birthday. Diana was the mother of William and Harry, and her activism and glamour made her an international icon, remembered with enduring affection.
